ITA-1.9.3.2.4 jñaḥ ज्ञः
The knower
Perceiver of knowledge, soul.

ITA-1.5.5 jñānam ज्ञानम्
Understanding, religious knowledge
A wider form of knowledge centred on a cognitive event that is recognized when experienced.

ITA-3.10.4 jñānendriyam ज्ञानेन्द्रियम्
Sensory faculty
The five sensory or cognitive faculties: auditory, visual, gustatory, olfactory and tactile sensory faculties.
